body:
Audited application revision c0dc1f1. Reproduced seven defects involving Focus failure isolation and pin limits, stale counter dates after remote timezone changes, live-update recovery, minute-based pagination, command confirmation and response validators. Measured expensive source scans in release builds. Full local checks and all 17 Chromium regression suites passed; additional synthetic probes exposed the uncovered cases.

Findings, priorities, measurements and simplification recommendations: progress/2026-09-29-repository-audit.md. No application fixes, scope changes or acceptance changes were made.

metadata.summary: Repository audit identifies recovery, Focus and counter-date defects
